title: 第十二章 沈君壁
novel_title: 凡人修仙：谁说修仙必须灵力
content_zh:
回到客栈，侯紫吃过晚饭，躺在床铺上，盯着天花板出神。

    沈君壁。这人是什么来路？一个码头账房，手指骨节分明，不是干粗活磨出来的老茧，是写字磨出来的茧。他怎么会知道修士？修士这个听孙墨说过，是什么呢？

    这人应该不坏。傍晚在码头上，他没声张，还主动帮忙找船。去会会，反正他在明我在暗，见机行事就行。

    侯紫翻身坐起来，把三寸小剑滑进靴筒，推门出去。

    柳树湾在汉口镇西边，是个废弃的老渡口。以前商船都在这里停，后来修了新码头，这里就荒了。拴船的石墩还在，上面长满了青苔，柳树垂在岸边，枝条扫着水面。月光照在渡口的碎石滩上，白惨惨的。

    侯紫远远就看见渡口上有火光。他闪到一棵柳树后面，手张开接风。风从江面灌过来，把渡口上的动静清清楚楚地送进他掌心里。

    沈君壁正被两个人架着胳膊摁在地上，脸上已经青了一块，嘴角有血。一个身材偏胖的蹲在他面前，翻着他的包袱，把里面的东西一件一件扔在地上。账本、算盘、几件旧衣服，还有一个小布包。胖子捡起布包打开，里面是一块成色极好的玉佩，在篝火旁泛着温润的光泽。

    他把玉佩连着布包握在手里，站起来说：“你这账房，平时看着穷得叮当响，身上还藏着这种好东西。说，从哪偷的？”

    沈君壁抬起头，说“那不是偷的，是父亲留给他的东西。”

    胖子嗤笑一声，说：“一个码头账房的爹能留下这种东西，骗谁呢。”

    旁边那个偏瘦的补了一句：“管它怎么来的，反正现在归我们了。”

    沈君壁没有说话。他抬头看了那两人一眼。那眼神和侯紫傍晚在巷口看到的完全不一样，是冷，冷得像一把没出鞘的刀。他在码头蹲了几年，挨过无数次揍，但从来没有用这种眼神看过任何人。那块玉佩是他父亲留给他的唯一信物。

    胖子被那眼神盯得发毛，一脚踹在沈君壁肚子上。沈君壁闷哼一声，整个人弯在地上，脸贴着碎石，嘴里涌出一口血沫。

    瘦子蹲下去揪着他的头发把他的脸抬起来，说：“再问一遍，这玉佩到底哪来的。”

    沈君壁嘴角淌着血，声音沙哑，说：“那是我父亲留给他的东西，拿回来。”

    胖子笑了，说：“想要拿回来也行，跪下来求。”
content_en:
Back at the inn, Hou Zi had dinner, lay on the bed, and stared at the ceiling in trance.

Shen Junbi.Where did this person come from?A dock clerk's fingers have sharp joints, calluses not from rough work but calluses from writing.How did he know about the monk?I heard Sun Mo say this monk, what is it?

This guy shouldn't be bad.At the dock in the evening, he kept silent and took the initiative to help find a boat.Go and have a meeting, anyway, he is showing it and I am hiding it, just act according to the situation.

Hou Zi turned over and sat up, slid the three-inch sword into his boot, pushed the door open and went out.

Willow Bay is an abandoned old ferry to the west of Hankou Town.Merchant ships used to stop here, but later a new wharf was built and the place became deserted.The stone pier to which the boat was tied is still there, covered with moss, and willow trees hang down on the shore, their branches sweeping the water.The moonlight shone on the gravel beach at the ferry, making it pale.

Hou Zi saw firelight on the ferry from a distance.He ducked behind a willow tree and opened his hands to catch the wind.The wind blew from the river and clearly conveyed the movements on the ferry into his palms.

Shen Junbi was being held down by two people with his arms on the ground. His face was already bruised and there was blood at the corner of his mouth.A fat man squatted in front of him, rummaged through his baggage, and threw the items on the ground one by one.Account books, abacus, a few old clothes, and a small cloth bag.The fat man picked up the cloth bag and opened it. Inside was a jade pendant of excellent quality, glowing with a warm luster by the campfire.

He held the jade pendant and the cloth bag in his hand, stood up and said, "Your accountant usually looks very poor, but you still have such a good thing hidden in your body. Where did you steal it from?"

Shen Junbi raised his head and said, "That was not stolen, it was something left to him by his father."

The fat man sneered and said, "Who can you kid if a dock accountant can leave such a thing?"

The thin one next to him added: "No matter how it came about, it belongs to us now."

Shen Junbi said nothing.He looked up at the two men.That look was completely different from what Hou Zi saw at the alley in the evening. It was cold, as cold as an unsheathed knife.He had squatted on the dock for several years and had been beaten countless times, but he had never looked at anyone with this look.That jade pendant was the only token left to him by his father.

The fat man was so stunned by that look that he kicked Shen Junbi in the stomach.Shen Junbi groaned and bent down on the ground, his face pressed against the gravel, and a mouthful of blood foamed out of his mouth.

The thin man squatted down, grabbed his hair, raised his face, and said, "Ask me again, where did this jade pendant come from?"

With blood dripping from the corner of Shen Junbi's mouth and his voice hoarse, he said, "That's what my father left for him. Take it back."

The fat man smiled and said, "You can take it back if you want, just kneel down and beg."
